assumes.if_other: Strict D8 places research content inside Global and Local; free views require an owner D8 change and matching workload evidence. Tool-authoring placement still needs the owner.

assumes.if_other: The owner-selected allowance/order controls future runs and gates; pending evidence stays pending under any order.

assumes.if_other: A separate declared per-run plan allowance needs LP1 versioned units, tariffs and registry reconciliation before KN7:budget.display_plan_limit can activate; no new budget dimension is inferred.

owner_items.why: Only the owner chooses built-ins, the compiled subset or a separately contracted user shader language; all remain open.
Only the owner chooses the feature handoff or fit-to-frozen-renderer alternative and resolves any required-feature conflict.
Research and tool-authoring placement and any change to D8 are owner decisions; no UI/UX work is reopened.
Pick disambiguation is a product choice reserved to the owner when the design line resumes.
The owner sets language scope, profiles and the product cut; support reporting cannot reduce the scope.
Boundary policy and its flow-control form remain with the owner and the existing chapter 07 process.
Any eventual model/geometry identity change for exposed faces requires the owner and the immutable-model process; the supplied unavailable-geometry contract authorizes none.
Renderer selection, experiment allowance and freeze order remain existing owner/gate decisions. This packet supplies no ruling.

JI.41's producer text is supplied, while J10 geometry/size inputs and backend evidence stay outstanding under RM.33. FR-K05 remains partial; no renderer selection or feature-freeze pass follows.

publication-replacement.given: View v has generation 7 installed. Accepted command A is preparing generation 8. Command B is accepted for generation 9 before A completes; A then delivers a late ready result.
publication-replacement.expected: A has exactly cancelled(superseded(by: B.command)); its late resources cannot install. Generation 7 remains whole until B installs, when B has completed with Completion.kind=view_published and covered generation 9. If A had already completed first, its completed terminal would stay unchanged.

device-loss.given: Device epoch 3 has a completed installed publication and one accepted pending publication B. A pick and presented-preview report are in flight. Mechanical command M has already committed. The device is lost.
device-loss.expected: B ends failed(EV3:busy.renderer_unavailable); if associated with a job, its JobResult is error(Error) with the contextual stop form under RM.22/LI.28. The completed publication and M keep their terminals. Input and presented-preview latches clear. Epoch-3 picks/reports/resources cannot be used after recovery. New resources bind immutable geometry and the latest complete engine bundle, and publications are revalidated separately.

fixed-ceiling.given: A standalone publication has 5 instances already available at admission. Its pinned host/profile and backend minima give instances=4; all other counts, source data and output allowance fit.
fixed-ceiling.expected: refused(EV3:resource_limit.display_plan_ceiling) before acceptance, with field instances, requested 5, ceiling 4; no pending work is superseded and nothing installs. The same request with 4 instances passes this limit.

output-exhausted.given: Accepted publication A requires 101 canonical uncompressed bytes; its run has 100 output bytes left. All fixed ceilings fit, and compression would make the transport smaller.
output-exhausted.expected: JobResult.outcome=cut_off(KN7:budget.output); Receipt.status=cancelled(budget). No part installs and the 101-byte publication is not emitted. The terminal reserve carries no user output; prior charges are not refunded. Compression does not change the outcome.

presented-preview.given: Preview P1 is confirmed in frame 40. P2 is received and submitted in frame 41, whose presentation is still pending. The device/surface epoch is unchanged.
presented-preview.expected: The newest confirmed report still names P1. ONE.41 can bind only P1 subject to engine freshness, never P2 yet. A later valid P2 report advances the latch; a delayed frame-40 report cannot roll it back. An unavailable report or device loss clears eligibility.

rejected-replacement.given: A is accepted and pending. Standalone B for the same view has its payload at admission, with a dangling SourceMap reference, and is refused before acceptance.
rejected-replacement.expected: B returns refused(EV3:input.display_plan_invalid); A is not cancelled or replaced and may still complete after its own final validation.

optional-feature.given: A backend lacks F25 NVIDIA enhancements while every required feature for the admitted scope is supported.
optional-feature.expected: F25 absence is a conforming optional omission; enhancements stay off by default, and correctness and selection criteria are unchanged.

FR-B04.scope: Display side only; p2a/p2b own command-table, undo and lane reconciliation.

derived-state-plan.given: Session revision 12 is adopted. A valid plan names derived kernel subject D, its derivation, lineage, level, reachability reference and display base 12, with matching immutable inputs. It is the only plan in this derived view.
derived-state-plan.expected: Publication ends completed(view_published); host metadata identifies subject_kind=derived, subject digest D and comparison base 12. Session state remains revision 12; D gains no session revision or commit path. Picks retain D, and the derived view reports no_preview. A state revision 13 makes this state-dependent output stale instead of attaching it to revision 13.

imported-subject.given: A KN2.14 imported value has no session ancestor; its plan names the import digest and explicit comparison base 12.
imported-subject.expected: The host identifies a derived display with imported lineage and retains the import digest; it invents no kernel derivation or session revision, and the subject cannot be the session or engine preview.
